title: Negative quantity in cart — negative charge
desc: Cart API accepted negative quantities. Setting -100 on expensive item made total negative.
steps:
1. Add item to cart
2. PATCH cart item with quantity: -100
3. Cart total goes negative — checkout credits account

title: Race condition on coupon — apply multiple times
desc: Coupon validation and redemption not atomic. Concurrent requests applied same one-time coupon multiple times.
steps:
1. Get single-use coupon
2. Send 20 concurrent POST /apply-coupon
3. Multiple succeed before DB marks it used

title: Price manipulation via parameter tampering
desc: Checkout accepted price from client-side. Modifying price to $0.01 completed purchase at attacker-set price.
steps:
1. Add item, intercept checkout request
2. Modify price to 0.01
3. Submit — purchase completes at $0.01

title: Double spend via concurrent withdrawal requests
desc: Withdrawal balance check and deduction not atomic. Concurrent requests both passed balance check.
steps:
1. Have $100 balance
2. Send 2 concurrent $100 withdrawal requests
3. Both pass balance check — $200 withdrawn from $100

title: Bypass report submission limit via API
desc: UI enforced max 10 drafts but API had no limit. Directly calling API allowed unlimited drafts.
steps:
1. Reach UI limit of 10 drafts
2. Call API directly: POST /api/reports
3. No limit enforced

title: Free rides via promo code reuse after refund
desc: Promo code marked used only after ride completion. Requesting refund reset code to unused.
steps:
1. Apply promo code to ride
2. Complete ride
3. Request refund — promo code reset
4. Apply same code again — infinite free rides

title: Bypass tweet character limit via API
desc: UI enforced 280 chars but API had no server-side validation. Posting 10,000 char tweets via API.
steps:
1. Craft tweet > 280 chars
2. POST directly to API
3. Tweet posted — bypasses UI limit

title: Discount stacking beyond intended limit
desc: Multiple discount codes could be applied simultaneously. Stacking 10 codes resulted in negative price.
steps:
1. Find multiple valid discount codes
2. Apply all simultaneously via API
3. Total discount exceeds 100% — negative price

title: Fake GPS route to earn achievements
desc: Strava accepted GPS coordinates without validation. Submitting fake route earned achievements.
steps:
1. Craft GPX file with impossible speed
2. Upload via API
3. Segment records and achievements awarded
payload:
POST /api/uploads
Content-Type: application/gpx+xml
# GPX with coordinates spanning 100km in 1 second

title: Send messages to channels without membership
desc: Message API did not verify channel membership. Any authenticated user could post to any channel.
steps:
1. Find target channel ID
2. POST /api/chat.postMessage with channel ID
3. Message appears — no membership check
